_readme: Hand-curated events: the ones worth keeping after the auto feed scrolls past. Add newest first. tags = prediction ids (P1..P7) and/or loop/contradiction ids (P1-loop..N4, C1..C3). source should be a URL where possible.

items.title: US bombers loaded for strikes, then stood down
items.note: The template for C1, the credibility trap: escalation prepared, then withheld on domestic cost.

items.title: Iran economic-collapse clock: ~70% inflation, oil exports halted ~7 weeks, running on floating storage
items.note: Iran's binding constraint. It limits how long P2-loop pressure can be sustained from Tehran's side.
